question: Which items are assigned to the loci of the letters ū and ṛ?
premises: Specific placements are made in syllabic loci.
The locus of ū receives a natural linga.
The locus of ṛ receives red ochre.
inference: One should place a natural linga in the locus of ū and red ochre in the locus of ṛ.
plain_english: One should place a natural linga in the locus of the letter ū, and red ochre in the locus of the letter ṛ.
